experiment: Resolve spin and orbital transitions on the same wall in a uniform flux. Diagnostic follow-up after grating acquisition. The sign of the laboratory electron anomaly was known. No measured magnitude or energy scale enters selection.
spin_readout: Mirror the private dimer and exchange its orbitals, times sigma_z. Gamma equals rest spin on the lowest positive wall branch.
level_readout: In each grade retain all six returned roots around the positive rest line. Use the rest-spin n=0 Gaussian and n=1 odd Hermite preparation weights to assign the two transitions; require distinct winners and record all weights. Compare 2 times the spin gap divided by the same-spin orbital gap for each charge. Averaging the two orbital gaps estimates the common kinetic spacing.
gate: Charge reversal exchanges grades. The ratio moves toward the independently predicted grating g as flux decreases and agrees within 0.05 at the finest carrier. Record any gate failure. Roots are diagnostic around the wall pole, not a survey of the high magnetic spectrum.
